title: [Bug]: testcontainers spock (and maybe others?) 1.20.5 upgraded minimum jdk version
body:
### Module

Core

### Testcontainers version

testcontainers-spock 1.20.5

### Using the latest Testcontainers version?

Yes

### Host OS

Mac

### Host Arch

ARM

### Docker version

```shell
4.38.0 (181591)
```

### What happened?

We started seeing the following error when trying to upgrade `testcontainers-spock` from 1.20.4 to 1.20.5:

```
       at java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:750)
  Caused by: java.lang.UnsupportedClassVersionError: org/testcontainers/spock/Testcontainers has been compiled by a more recent version of the Java Runtime (class file version 61.0), this version of the Java Runtime only recognizes class file versions up to 52.0
        at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass1(Native Method)
        at java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass(ClassLoader.java:757)
        at java.security.SecureClassLoader.defineClass(SecureClassLoader.java:142)
        at java.net.URLClassLoader.defineClass(URLClassLoader.java:473)
        at java.net.URLClassLoader.access$100(URLClassLoader.java:74)
        at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(URLClassLoader.java:369)
        at java.net.URLClassLoader$1.run(URLClassLoader.java:363)
        at java.security.AccessController.doPrivileged(Native Method)
        at java.net.URLClassLoader.findClass(URLClassLoader.java:362)
        at java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:419)
        at java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:406)
        at groovy.lang.GroovyClassLoader.loadClass(GroovyClassLoader.java:862)
        at groovy.lang.GroovyClassLoader.loadClass(GroovyClassLoader.java:736)
        at org.codehaus.groovy.ast.decompiled.AsmReferenceResolver.resolveJvmClass(AsmReferenceResolver.java:84)
        at org.codehaus.groovy.ast.decompiled.DecompiledClassNode.getTypeClass(DecompiledClassNode.java:81)
        at org.codehaus.groovy.ast.ClassNode.getTypeClass(ClassNode.java:1459)
        at org.codehaus.groovy.transform.ASTTransformationCollectorCodeVisitor.getTransformClassAnnotation(ASTTransformationCollectorCodeVisitor.java:266)
``` 

Looking at bytecode output:

1.20.4 results in:

```
Classfile /org/testcontainers/spock/Testcontainers.class
  Last modified Nov 19, 2024; size 582 bytes
  SHA-256 checksum 9f70a6ddadf3acd747024df0005d71ba4c1ae4d97be95ffa1c0ffdd15fcff920
  Compiled from "Testcontainers.groovy"
public interface org.testcontainers.spock.Testcontainers extends java.lang.annotation.Annotation
  minor version: 0
  major version: 52 
```
 while 1.20.5:

```
Classfile 
/1.20.5/org/testcontainers/spock/Testcontainers.class
  Last modified Dec 11, 2024; size 582 bytes
  SHA-256 checksum eb10b945ac23d3797f7d870fdb693f490bbeac17b256e609cc0e88d053ef3b34
  Compiled from "Testcontainers.groovy"
public interface org.testcontainers.spock.Testcontainers extends java.lang.annotation.Annotation
  minor version: 0
  major version: 61
``` 

It might be related to https://github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-java/blob/main/build.gradle#L39-L43. I do see the core module not being affected but wondering if other modules suffer from this
